draft.subject: Qinghe across your holdings: 29.0% of your wealth
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

There is one figure I would like you to see, because no single statement shows it. Counting everything linked to Qinghe Battery Technology, it comes to 29.0% of your wealth with us.

That is made up of the Qinghe shares, including the additional purchase you instructed after the first-quarter results; the Equity Linked Note on Qinghe, paying 10.5% a year over 6 months; and the Fixed Coupon Note on Basket Q, paying 9.0% a year over 12 months, whose outcome is also tied to Qinghe. The two notes look like income, but their outcome depends on the same company as the shares.

I know you want to stay invested in the supply chain you know, and that is your decision to make. My concern is only that your business and a large part of your portfolio now depend on the same company. What I would suggest is that we look at the total together and you decide whether it is the position you want; if it is, I will note that on your file.

Could I call you this week?
draft.client_language:
[[FIRST_NAME]] 您好：

有一个数字我希望您能看到，因为任何一份单独的结单都不会显示它。把所有与 Qinghe Battery Technology 挂钩的持仓合计，占您在我们这里财富的 29.0%。

这包括 Qinghe 股份本身（其中包括您在第一季度业绩公布后指示追加买入的部分）；以 Qinghe 为标的、年息 10.5%、期限 6 个月的股票挂钩票据；以及以 Basket Q 为标的、年息 9.0%、期限 12 个月、结果同样与 Qinghe 挂钩的固定票息票据。这两张票据看起来像是收益产品，但它们的结果取决于与股份相同的公司。

我知道您希望继续投资于您熟悉的产业链，这是您的决定。我只是担心，您的事业和组合中很大一部分如今都取决于同一家公司。我的建议是我们一起看看这个总数，由您决定这是否是您想要的持仓；如果是，我会把这一点记录在您的档案中。

我可否在本周致电与您详谈？
draft.raises: Asks her to look at the combined Qinghe exposure and confirm whether it is the position she wants.
